Command FLAC files are synthetic development recordings generated with pyopenjtalk 0.4.1 and the default mei_normal HTS voice. Voice copyright (c) 2009–2013 Nagoya Institute of Technology; Creative Commons Attribution 3.0. See MEI-LICENSE.txt. Source: https://github.com/r9y9/pyopenjtalk/tree/v0.4.1/pyopenjtalk/htsvoice . Generation changes: game command text and resampling to mono 16 kHz.

reference.json contains the input text. small-results.json and wasm-results.json are actual outputs measured with the current shared inference core. turbo-results.json preserves verbatim outputs from the earlier native q8 comparison on 2026-10-14; GPU fp16 was not measured. activity-results.json comes from the shipped Silero WASM, including a publicly available natural Japanese sample. These are development fixtures, not an accuracy benchmark using the player's voice or a real-browser test.
